title: Complement of the Menger Sponge
body: An 'inverted' Menger sponge or technically the Complement of the Menger Sponge. While the standard Menger sponge is formed by repeatedly drilling holes out of a solid cube, the inverted version is the shape of the holes themselves. This results in adding multiple 3D crosses each iteration.

title: MACROS
body: A collection of my most used MACROS in LaTeX. To use the file just move it to the same directory of your LaTeX file after downloading it and then add \usepackage{MACROS} in the preamble.

title: Theorems Styles
body: A list of common styles for theorems, lemmas, etc. To use the file just move it to the same directory of your LaTeX file after downloading it and then add \usepackage{styles} in the preamble.

title: Physics Macros

title: LaTeX CLI
body: A command line tool to setup a LaTeX Project. Creating a main.tex file and adding all the MACROS and dependencies needed.
